full_prompt_en: The image is a square photograph of a dense installation of weathered standing figures, with a few bright yellow and red forms in the front row. The composition is seen straight on. Human-sized sculptural silhouettes pack the frame from the lower edge to the top, standing shoulder to shoulder in many staggered tiers. Their heads and torsos repeat as narrow vertical units, while small changes in height, clothing outline, and pose keep the grid irregular. Most surfaces are dark charcoal, slate gray, olive, and brown, rubbed with old-looking speckles and fragments of faded red, teal, ochre, and cream pigment. At the bottom center, one bright yellow figure stands out through its colored face and patterned clothing. Immediately to its right, a vivid red hooded figure forms another strong accent. A pale white figure appears higher on the right, and scattered turquoise and orange patches interrupt the upper mass. The front row stands on a light stone ledge whose block joints are visible below their feet. Behind the figures there is almost no independent background; more ranks fill every gap and recede upward into shadow. The viewer's eye moves first to the yellow and red pair, then through repeated dark bodies toward small colored notes in the distance. Outdoor-like even light reveals rough, chipped material and tiny paint deposits on each surface. Dark seams between the forms supply the deepest values, while the pale ledge anchors the bottom. The image feels like a crowded textured wall made from individual presences, balancing repetitive mass with a handful of vivid color interruptions.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形摄影：密集装置中的风化站立人形，前排点着几尊亮黄与红色形体。构图从正面观看。真人大小的雕塑剪影从下画边挤到顶部，许多错落的层级里肩并肩站着。头与躯干重复成窄竖向单元，高度、衣服轮廓和姿态的细小变化又让网格不规整。多数表面为深炭、板岩灰、橄榄和棕色，擦出陈旧斑点与褪色红、青、赭和奶油色颜料碎片。下方中央，一尊亮黄人形凭有色面孔和纹样衣服跳出。紧挨其右，一尊鲜红连帽人形成为另一处强点。较高的右侧有一尊浅白人形，上部团块中散落青绿与橙色斑片。前排站在浅石台缘上，他们脚下可见石块接缝。人物背后几乎没有独立背景；更多层队填满缝隙，向上退入阴影。视线先落在黄与红的一对，再沿重复暗色身体走向远处小彩点。近乎户外的均匀光照出每块表面的粗糙、剥落材料与细微颜料沉积。形体间的暗缝给出最深明度，浅台缘压住底部。图像像一面由个体存在组成的拥挤纹理墙，让重复的大群与少量鲜艳色彩间断保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Frontal photographic documentation compresses many repeated narrow vertical forms into a nearly continuous wall. Staggered tiers create a packed rhythm with only thin dark seams between units. Rough, chipped, paint-worn surfaces carry mottled charcoal, slate, olive, rust, and muted teal; a few saturated yellow and scarlet accents interrupt the field. Even light makes small material changes visible without strong directional shadows. A narrow pale base establishes scale and horizontal stability beneath the dense upward spread. Depth is shallow but legible through overlap and progressive darkening. The overall image feels monumental and tactile, with repetition providing structure and isolated bright areas providing focus.
style_prompt_zh: 正面的摄影记录把许多重复的窄竖向形体压成几乎连续的一面墙。错落层级构成拥挤节奏，单元之间只剩细暗缝。粗糙、剥落、磨掉颜料的表面带斑驳炭黑、板岩色、橄榄、锈色与低饱和青绿；少数饱和黄与猩红点缀打断整片色场。均匀光让细小材质变化可见，却没有强烈定向投影。窄浅色底座在密集向上扩张之下建立尺度与横向稳定。纵深虽浅，仍由遮叠与渐暗读出。整体图像巨大而可触，重复给出结构，孤立亮区提供焦点。
theme_en: Dense rows of weathered standing figures with bright yellow and red accents
theme_zh: 密集排列的风化站立人形中点着亮黄与红色
name: Liu Bolin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
